description: This Java source file defines an Android activity class 'TranslucentGLSurfaceViewActivity' which demonstrates the use of GLSurfaceView for rendering translucent 3D graphics. It initializes a GLSurfaceView, configures its pixel format for translucency, sets a renderer, and manages activity lifecycle methods to handle rendering appropriately.
external_methods: GLSurfaceView.setEGLConfigChooser(int, int, int, int, int, int)

classes.name: TranslucentGLSurfaceViewActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating the setup of a translucent GLSurfaceView for rendering 3D graphics.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GLSurfaceView, configures pixel format and renderer, and sets it as the activity's content view.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Resumes the GLSurfaceView rendering when the activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the GLSurfaceView rendering when the activity pauses.
